title: Dog Sofa Beds
seo_title: Dog Sofa Beds: A Seat of Their Own | PawLunova
seo_description: Ten minutes of staring, then they are on your sofa. Dog sofa beds with arms to lean on, foam under most and low fronts for stiff dogs. Choose theirs.

image.alt: Shaggy grey dog asleep on the Grasmere memory foam dog sofa beside a cushioned arm in a sunlit room

intro_html: They start on the floor, stare at you for ten minutes, then end up on your sofa. A dog sofa bed gives them the arm, the seat and the company.
description_html:
A dog sofa bed is for an evening routine you probably know well: curtains shut, telly on, the dog on the floor staring at you until they give up and climb onto your sofa. It is not naughtiness. Your sofa has the soft seat, the armrest and the company. A sofa bed gives them all three on a seat of their own, close enough to hear you move.

Choosing a dog sofa bed by how they rest

  • If they keep watch, head up: Haweswater has raised sofa-style sides to prop a chin on. Esthwaite and Bowfell use an L-shaped bolster along two sides, so their back is covered and the room stays in view.
  • If they lean and flop: Grasmere has three cushioned arms and an open front, in four sizes from 80 × 60cm to 135 × 100cm.
  • If they curl up tight: Skelwith is bolstered on all four sides around a fleece middle, at 76 × 51cm.
  • If it has to look like furniture: Windsor is upholstered, with piped seams, furniture-weight fabric, a back and two arms, in Blue, Green, Brown or Grey.

Want the arm without the furniture look? Our bolster dog beds do the same job more simply.

For stiff mornings: a lower way in

Often the first thing you notice is not a limp but a hesitation at the edge of the bed. Newlands, Easedale and Burnmoor keep a bolster on all four sides but drop the front section, so they step in rather than climb. Braithwaite cuts one corner open, chaise-style. These four use profiled egg-crate foam, which spreads weight rather than compressing flat, with a waterproof liner or lining around the foam for wet coats and accidents. Grasmere, Haweswater, Windsor and Skelwith use memory foam, and their foam cores carry a 5-year no-flatten guarantee, subject to the guarantee terms. For more low-entry shapes, see our orthopaedic dog beds. A sofa bed is about comfort, not treatment; for pain or stiffness, keep talking to your vet.

Sizes from small dogs to giants

Braithwaite, Skelwith and Newlands suit small and medium dogs. For big dogs, Easedale and Scafell are 106.5 × 81.5cm, Bowfell 122 × 91cm, and Burnmoor 132 × 104cm and 20cm deep. The arms sit inside the outside footprint, so check the seat they will actually lie on against their length lying flat, plus 15 to 20cm. Between sizes, go up.

100 nights on a seat of their own

Every sofa bed here is covered by the 100-night trial from delivery. If they still prefer your sofa after a fair try, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund, with one trial per household and damage and other exclusions applying. Standard UK delivery is free on orders over £40. The trial in full.

Dog sofa bed questions

Will my dog stay off my sofa if they have their own?

Nobody can honestly promise that. What a sofa bed does is offer the same three things, an arm, a soft seat and a view of you, so they have a good reason to stay on theirs. Haweswater and Grasmere are both sized to sit right beside your chair.

Can I wash a dog sofa bed?

On most of these the cover comes off; wash it following the sewn-in label and never wash or soak the foam. Where there is a liner, wipe it, then let everything air-dry fully before refitting.

Which dog sofa bed is easiest to get into?

The ones with a lowered front, Newlands, Easedale and Burnmoor, or Grasmere, whose open front has nothing to step over at all.

Not sure which of these suits them? The Bed Finder decides from how they sleep.
